heading: Safer file operations and clearer tab groups
summary: This update protects local files during rename, adds a recoverable remote editing flow, and keeps new tabs visible under group filters.
changes: If the destination name already exists, PromeFTP stops and preserves both files.
Open a remote file in your text editor, choose whether to upload it, and keep a local copy if upload is skipped or fails.
New connections join the selected tab group while a group filter is active.
The PromeFTP mark combines a letter P with a file corner and transfer arrow.
notice: Close active sessions before updating. Requires macOS 13 or later on Apple Silicon.
